title: Wolf's Lament
description: A dark surreal night scene featuring two wolves howling at a pale moon. On the right, the face of a pale woman with black tears streaming down her cheeks and dripping into a pool of water below.
prompt: A haunting dark surreal night scene with two wolves howling, the foreground wolf has blood on its snout and neck. To the right a pale woman's face with long black tears streaming down and dripping into a pool of water. Dark stormy sky with a small pale moon, purple and red mist over dark water, atmospheric and moody, painted in a painterly style.
